latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Generator for DaVinci Resolve.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or MKV videos (up to 500MB) and auto-generate subtitles, with results delivered as 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Streamlined workflow: no need to interact with DaVinci Resolve’s manual captioning tools.
- Automatic connection and session management with backend cloud API; handles tokens and session creation for you.
- Clear handling for uploads, exports, credits, session state, and real-time updates on progress.
- Guidance for best file formats and workflows, along with fast batch and iterative editing options.
